DraftKings price: CHI +15.5 at 1.87 (feed). DraftKings Network quotes BOS -15.5 at -105 (1.952), consistent with the feed's home price.
No-vig market p for CHI cover 0.511 (payload p_market).
arithmetic: Adjusted BOS margin = 11.7 + 1.5 (Claxton out, estimate for a starting C; not measured) - 0.5 (Carter out, reserve guard; estimate) = +12.7. Adjustments are estimates, so the evidence is partial.
Team margin for CHI = -12.7. P(CHI cover) = Phi((-12.7 + 15.5) / 12.6) = Phi(0.222) = 0.588, shown as 0.59.
Desk vs no-vig market: 0.59 - 0.511 = +7.7 points, inside the 8-point re-check line. The unadjusted model gives 0.619 (the board's p 0.549 is its nudged figure).
Fair odds for CHI +15.5 at the desk p = 1 / 0.588 = 1.70; DraftKings 1.87 is above it.
pros: Boston's net-rating gap is large (BOS 3-1, +4.7 net; CHI 1-4, -4.5 net), and the model gives BOS 11.7 before news.
Claxton out removes CHI's main rim protector and rebounder; that effect is not in the box-score ratings, so the desk adds it.
A 15.5-point line requires a BOS win by 16 or more; the desk's expected margin is about 12.7.
risks: Blowout risk: the market (no-vig 0.51) implies BOS by about 15. A margin of 16 or more covers BOS, and a 2.8-point gap to the market is the main disagreement.
Adjustments are estimates: the Claxton effect (+1.5) and the Carter effect (-0.5) have no measured source. A sharper estimate of either moves p by about 3 points per point of margin.
Smith (starting C in recent games) and Williams are game-time or questionable; if both are out, CHI's depth shrinks further and the margin widens.
Carter's status is from the payload's ESPN entry and an 2026-10-29 preview; no same-day official report confirmed it.
